label: sec:confinement-selection-confinement-sdp-vs-preamble
html: Comparing the semidefinite program against its linear-programming relaxation determines which multi-strand correlation constraints survive scalar projection. This subsection formulates the multi-input semidefinite confinement condition, proves the topological no-decay obstruction from Gram positivity, and uses it with the confinement SDP to prove shell-closure stability and level sufficiency for confined particles and the phase stratification that scopes every confinement statement to one connected component of the confinement locus. It establishes LP-dual stability across the active Wedderburn support. It then proves algebraic primality for irreducible magic closures (noting the vacuous base case n = 1) and derives the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta cosine resummation comparing the Markov trace at z = q^3/(q^2+1) against the spectral-bridge log-ratio.
